content.user_title: Capture Convex Production Errors with Sentinel
content.value_statement: Production failures can be difficult to collect and investigate without exposing sensitive data. This skill guides Sentinel setup, redaction, monitoring, and optional automated triage.
actual_capabilities: Guides installation of the Sentinel component in a Convex configuration.
Explains client error capture through React boundaries and browser error events.
Requires write-time redaction for secret names and sensitive value patterns.
Describes inspection of recent errors through Convex CLI operations.
Outlines optional triage for recurring, non-transient production errors.
limitations: Production error capture requires a deployed Convex cloud application.
The skill provides setup guidance rather than a bundled implementation or executable installer.
Automated fix pull requests require separate ai-runner integration.
Sampling and volume limits must be selected for each application.

use_cases.title: Add Production Monitoring
use_cases.description: Configure Sentinel to collect server and client failures inside an existing Convex deployment.

use_cases.title: Protect Diagnostic Data
use_cases.description: Apply mandatory write-time redaction before production error records can reach an AI model provider.

use_cases.title: Automate Error Triage
use_cases.description: Plan recurring error classification and optional pull request creation for maintainable production operations.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Installation
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through adding Sentinel to my Convex application. Identify the configuration file changes and prerequisites before making edits.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer is installing Sentinel for the first time.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Client Capture
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Sentinel client error capture to my React application. Include an error boundary, browser error events, promise rejection handling, and breadcrumbs.
prompt_templates.scenario: A React developer needs structured client failure reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Review Redaction Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Sentinel error capture design for sensitive data exposure. Verify default-deny key filtering, value redaction, sampling, and storage limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: A security reviewer is validating production telemetry controls.

prompt_templates.title: Design Automated Triage
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Sentinel workflow that detects recurring non-transient errors, classifies them, and safely hands qualified issues to ai-runner for pull requests.
prompt_templates.scenario: An operations team wants controlled automated remediation.

output_examples.input: Help me add Sentinel to an existing Convex and React application.
output: Add the Sentinel component to the Convex application configuration.
Connect a React error boundary and browser error event handlers.
Confirm that write-time redaction remains enabled before deployment.

output_examples.input: How should I inspect and respond to recent production errors?
output_examples.output: Use Convex CLI data access to review recent records, then subscribe to production error events for a controlled response workflow.

output_examples.input: Can recurring errors create fix pull requests automatically?
output_examples.output: Enable triage only after classification rules are defined. Route recurring non-transient errors to ai-runner, and retain human review before merging changes.

best_practices: Keep redaction enabled and test it against representative secret names and values.
Apply sampling and storage caps that match production traffic and cost limits.
Review automated triage classifications before allowing pull request creation.
anti_patterns: Do not store raw secrets or unredacted request data in error records.
Do not send production error data to an undeclared third-party service.
Do not enable automated fixes without recurrence checks and human review.

faq.question: Where does Sentinel store captured errors?
faq.answer: It stores errors in a table within the user's own Convex deployment.

faq.question: Does production data leave the Convex deployment?
faq.answer: The workflow says data stays in the deployment. Agent reads can reach the configured model provider, so redaction is mandatory.

faq.question: Which errors can the client integration capture?
faq.answer: It covers React boundary failures, browser errors, unhandled promise rejections, and related breadcrumbs.

faq.question: Is redaction optional?
faq.answer: No. The skill requires write-time redaction and describes it as enabled by default.

faq.question: Can I inspect errors from the command line?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow references Convex CLI data access and one-time queries for recent errors.

faq.question: Does the skill automatically repair every error?
faq.answer: No. Self-healing is optional and targets recurring non-transient errors through a separate ai-runner workflow.
